title: Two neighbours meet
subtitle: Unit 1: hear it, read it, say it

steps.title: In the hallway
steps.body: Anna and Sam live in the same building. They meet in the hallway. Tap each line to hear it, then read the English.

examples.en: Anna: Hi! My name is Anna.
Sam: Hi! My name is Sam. Nice to meet you.
Anna: Nice to meet you. I live in Montréal.

examples.fr: J'habite à Toronto. Je parle anglais.
examples.en: Sam: I live in Toronto. I speak English.

steps.explain: Tu parles français ? means Do you speak French? Anna says tu because they are neighbours.

steps.prompt: Anna writes Enchantée with an extra e. Why?
steps.explain: A woman writes enchantée. You cannot hear the difference: both sound like ahn-shahn-TAY.

steps.tip: Say it as if you just met a neighbour. Use your own name.
Your voice goes up at the end. That makes it a question.

steps.title: Now you try
steps.body:
Say the whole conversation out loud with your own name and your own city.

Tap Ask Marie and ask her to play Anna, so you can practise it with someone.
